content.name: Renee Washington
content.title: Senior HR Generalist, SHRM-SCP
content.summary: SHRM-SCP certified HR generalist with 13 years in healthcare, biotech and aerospace manufacturing. Serves as the lead HR partner for 1,100 employees across two Washington plants, and cut first-year turnover from 31% to 19% with a redesigned onboarding and stay-interview program.

experience.title: Senior HR Generalist
bullets: Lead HR partner for 1,100 production and engineering employees across two plants, with two HR generalists reporting to me.
Redesigned onboarding and added 30- and 90-day stay interviews, cutting first-year turnover from 31% to 19%.
Investigate and close about 45 employee relations cases a year, with no agency charges sustained since 2022.
Administer FMLA, ADA accommodations and Washington Paid Family and Medical Leave in partnership with our leave vendor.
Led the Workday HCM rollout for the plants, training 140 supervisors on time-off and performance workflows.

experience.title: HR Generalist II
bullets: Supported a research and manufacturing workforce that grew from 380 to 720 employees in three years.
Built a compensation review process with salary bands for 60 job codes, closing pay gaps flagged in an equity audit.
Ran the annual open enrollment for medical, dental and 401(k), raising benefits survey satisfaction by 22 points.
Wrote the remote and hybrid work policy adopted in 2020 and updated the employee handbook.

experience.title: HR Generalist
bullets: Handled HR for 12 outpatient clinics and about 450 clinical and admin staff.
Tracked clinical licensure renewals and set up reminders that brought lapsed licenses to zero.
Coordinated union grievance meetings and kept files ready for arbitration.

experience.title: HR Coordinator
bullets: Processed new hires, terminations and status changes in the HRIS for 450 employees.
Scheduled about 300 interviews a year for clinical managers.
Ran I-9 audits and corrected 70 incomplete forms before an internal compliance review.

achievements.title: First-year turnover 31% to 19%
achievements.detail: Onboarding and stay-interview program at Cascade Aerostructures.

achievements.title: Workday rollout
achievements.detail: Trained 140 supervisors and went live on schedule in 2023.
